notes_for_editor: Build year and height conflict and no third source was found. Register: built 1942, 100-foot steel tower. Story map: built 1979 by Aermotor, 80 feet. The record has built 1942 and height_m 24.4 (80 ft), so the record follows the register for the year and the story map for the height; a human should decide. Current use is disputed: the register says staffed in fire season, while a 2019 visitor guide calls the tower abandoned. The staffing entry rests on the register alone and the guide may be out of date. The register names the Bureau of Forestry, while the park is a DCNR state park; the Bureau is a DCNR division, so this is not treated as an error. Web search found no history of the tower beyond the Wikipedia mountain article and the 2019 guide. The register's builder-plate photo credit is Mark Haughwout; no image URL was captured, so no photo was added.
